what: The zhen build study 2 measures. Built from source on the Mac mini, recorded before phase 1. Never rebuilt until the study ends.
version_note: The binary reports no commit: a plain `swift build -c release` of a clone embeds none. The link from this file to its source is this record (tag, commit, source_path), not `zhen --version`.
build_record: /Users/Shared/zhen-study2/build.json on the mini (moved there from ~zhenstudy/.zhen-study2/ by /study-setup on 2026-11-18)
sha256_meaning: Identifies this artifact within study 2, not this source. Builds are not reproducible byte for byte (REPRODUCIBILITY.md, 'What the checksum is for'); the commit plus the recipe above is how anyone else gets an equivalent one. The harness hashes the binary on every run, so a replacement is visible in the data.
frozen_packages: zhen-swift/zhen-core (the whole package: ZhenCore, ZhenDarwin, zhen)

supersedes.why: That build was made on the MacBook and could not be traced to its source by anyone else. Study 2 builds 0.8.1 from the public commit on the mini instead (LEDGER.md, 2026-11-06). 0.8.1 differs from 0.8.0 by the version string and a compiler fix for macOS 15.6; scan behaviour is unchanged. G9's flag checks re-run against this binary on the testbed in S2.
